name: ormeggio
description: Come back after days away and find every session where you left it. A hook notices that your last message was longer ago than your usual nights, reads the transcripts and tells Claude which sessions stalled on a usage limit, an expired login, a restart or a tool left halfway, and which ended with a question for you. The ormeggio skill resumes the stalled ones a dozen at a time after a memory check, and puts every open question in one place.
